summary: xAI released Grok Imagine Image 2.0, a new image generation and editing model available as Quality Mode on grok.com and in the API as grok-imagine-image-2.0.

practices.reason: Image 2.0 follows instructions more precisely and supports precise region-based editing, changing what a team could use it for in production creative pipelines.
practices.quote: 2.0 follows instructions closely, down to the details. It plans typography and layout the way a designer would, so dense, multi-part visuals hold together and small text comes out sharp.

practices.reason: The model's standing is supported by external Arena leaderboard rankings rather than a transferable in-house benchmark, useful context but not an instrument a team can directly run.
practices.quote: It ranks second in the world in both text-to-image generation and image editing. Image Edit Arena Text-to-Image Arena Overall Elo. Source: Arena Image Edit and Text-to-Image leaderboards (as of Aug 7, 2026 ).

practices.reason: A new model identifier is added to the API with no deprecation of prior versions, creating optional adoption work rather than mandatory migration.
practices.quote: Image 2.0 is available in the API as grok-imagine-image-2.0 .
